Reason for Mistake: The Coder agent made a critical error in Step 1 by incorrectly identifying the Latin root of the Yola word "gimlie" as "gemma" (meaning gem/bud). The word "gimlie" is actually derived from the Latin root "gemellus" (meaning twin), which shares its spelling with the Spanish word "gemelo" (twin). This initial etymological error led the entire multi-agent process down the wrong path, causing subsequent searches for the Spanish word "gema" (gem) instead of "gemelo" (twin), and ultimately resulting in the retrieval of an incorrect source title ("Cien años de soledad" instead of the correct title associated with "gemelo").
